_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. model sheet of a woman in her late twenties with short expensive dark hair, lighter smudged eyeliner, a camel wool coat, city boots, one hand in her coat pocket; front, profile, back (leaving), seated on a dock edge; expression heads: dry, fond, hollow, exhausted tenderness; labeled CHLOE 2008. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
